## How marks work (49)

The university’s and faculties’ assessment rules, the modules’ published schemes and the exam calendar (Phase 6a). Check every number against its quote and page; anything marked "not published" must really be absent from the source (never a usual 50% or 40%). Every source must be on the university’s own site.
